messages:
Sam (SE): Quick check — EvokeHealth pilot cutover scheduled Thu 2026-05-07 09:00 PT. Owners: infra handoff, SE testing, SSO cert. Who's owning net egress IPs + firewall rule? Need confirmation by EOD Tue.

Maria (PM): Success criteria for trial: 1) API error rate <1% during 10k requests/day window; 2) avg p50 latency <220ms; 3) embeddings lookup validated on 50k rows. I'll own acceptance sign-off. :white_check_mark:

Devin (Eng): I'll take model pin + rollout. PR 4821 has the model config and quantization flags. Still waiting on infra to assign static IPs. @Priya can you confirm?

Priya (Infra): Confirming we can reserve two egress IPs in us-west-2. Need the final CIDR list for firewall from Evoke. Est provisioning time: ~6hrs once we have CIDRs.

Alex (Solutions): On SE side I'll run full integration smoke: routing, token exchange, retry/backoff. Please add me to the Evoke testing workspace. One ask: we need an "integration" API key with read-only usage metrics.

Sam (SE): Re: test data — Evoke can provide sanitized payloads. Also calling out SSO cert renewal window: cert expires 2026-05-15 so we need rotation before go-live.

Devin (Eng): For cutover plan, I'm proposing a staged canary: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. If errors spike >1.5% rollback to prior model. Will document in PR 4827 (cutover runbook).

Priya (Infra): IP ranges we need from Evoke:
```
203.0.113.0/24
198.51.100.0/28
```
Share as soon as possible.

deploy-bot: New rollout scheduled for 2026-05-07T16:00:00Z (canary). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/evoke-4827

Maria (PM): Blockers logged in JIRA RED-3321 (SSO cert) and RED-3322 (Egress CIDRs). Can everyone add time estimates to those tickets by EOD?

Alex (Solutions): I'll ping Evoke for CIDRs and add the test key request. Expect update tomorrow AM.

Sam (SE): Thanks — short checklist for owners:
- Priya: reserve IPs + firewall rules
- Devin: model pin + cutover PR
- Alex: test key + workspace access
- Maria: acceptance gate
Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.

Maria (PM): :thumbsup:

Devin (Eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (Infra): :thumbsup:

Alex (Solutions): :thumbsup:

Sam (SE): Noted. I'll summarize the runbook and post final ops checklist here by 2026-05-05 18:00 PT.
